daily masses on tues. and fri. at 10.00am. reflection we all love a good meal with our friends and family . whenever we share a meal with those we love, there is a sense ofjoy, community and belonging which is experienced by those around the table.
the same is true at the time of jesus. we know that jesus sat and ate with many people.
to share a meal then was a sign of equality.
all around the table were seen as equals, nobody excluded.
jesus invites us to the table of the lord.
the euch arist is offered to us freely and we are invited to respond freely.
it is god's gift to us and no one is to be excluded.
